verdicts.reason: Both candidates break the layout the same way. The flavour names are pulled away from their descriptors and listed in reverse order (Honey Rosemary / Cucumber Mint / Blood Orange above, then Bright & zesty / Warm & herbal / Cool & crisp below), so no name sits with its own description. Three cans become one big can plus two tiny can fragments stuck beside the CTA, and the body copy and descriptors are too small to read. The centred text stack is jammed from the logo down to the bottom edge, and the CTA sits off the text's centre line. A puts the can on the left and leaves dead space on the right; B mirrors this with the can on the right and dead space on the left. Neither is meaningfully better.
